structured.answer: Harel has a ton of tracks, almost all around 0.5% fee; the one that stands out is the S&P 500 tracker (13.7% a year over 3 years, ~0.5–0.56% fee), and since my קרן השתלמות is at Harel I'd first check whether I'm already in that track.

stuck.where: Fee column, two lines מהחיסכון / מההפקדות
stuck.why: Didn't know if they add up or which one matters; pension rows show 1.47% from deposits which looked big
Many rows show no number at all, so I couldn't compare them
Fees split into קבועים/משתנים/נאמן and no returns shown; couldn't tell if cheaper or better than the S&P track above
Dozens of near-identical rows, got bored, scrolled past pension parts

Section headers with fee ranges (0.54% עד 0.61%, 0.41% עד 0.67%)

קרנות מחקות S&P 500 rows with 0% קבועים

findings.what: Huge wall of near-identical rows (96 tracks); no guidance on which fits a beginner
Many tracks show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, so they can't be compared
Two fee lines (מהחיסכון/מההפקדות) with no shekel example; 1.47% from deposits looks scarier than 0.16% and I can't tell which is worse
Returns are 'לפני דמי ניהול' but this is only in the small column header, easy to miss
Mutual funds/ETFs show fees split into three parts and no returns at all
findings.where: קרנות מחקות and קרנות סל tables, screens 10–12

findings.what: Wide desktop table; on a phone the left columns (money managed, arrows) would be missed
Jargon tags (צוברת, מנוטרלת מט"ח, נאמן) with no explanation next to them
Pension products mixed in with things I could actually put savings into
